'''BZ-9D''' was a traffic control droid that was in service at [[Mos Ila Spaceport]].<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] questioned the droid about the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]].<ref name="TOR:TtS" />
